title: Rosmarinus officinalis tea for medicinal use
intro: Rosmarinus officinalis tea is a herbal infusion made from the dried leaves of the rosemary plant, known for its aromatic and therapeutic properties. It is commonly used in herbalism to support digestion, enhance memory, and alleviate symptoms of depression and anxiety. The tea is often prepared by steeping the leaves in hot water for several minutes to release its essential oils and active compounds. In traditional medicine, it has been valued for its warming effects and ability to promote circulation. This preparation is also used in aromatherapy to help reduce stress and improve mental clarity.
